entities.summary: Electoral Action of Poles in Lithuania – Christian Families Alliance or EAPL–CFA is a political party in Lithuania. It positions itself as Christian-democratic. It has 3 seats in the Seimas, 1 seat in the European Parliament and 57 seats in municipal councils after the 2023 local election. Electoral Action of Poles in Lithuania is a political party in Vilnius, established in 1994-10-21. A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
